name: My Time With Dee Dee, Volume 0
source:
My Time With Dee Dee is a series of short visual novels staring the mascot of DigitallyDownloaded.net, Danica, or Dee Dee. This is a very short introduction, to give you a first look at Dee Dee, and how she came to meet you, the protagonist. 

[From [url=https://digitallydownld.itch.io/my-time-with-dee-dee-volume-0]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《My Time With Dee Dee》是一系列短篇视觉小说，主角是DigitallyDownloaded.net的吉祥物达妮卡，也就是迪迪。这是一段非常简短的序章，让你初步认识迪迪，并了解她是如何与你——本作主人公——相遇的。

[摘自[url=https://digitallydownld.itch.io/my-time-with-dee-dee-volume-0]Itch.io[/url]]
